title: The Ground-Truth Pack had never measured anything, and now it does
head: c9d0fe6
local_verification: 2751 passed, 5 xfailed. ruff clean. format clean. pyright 0 errors. .github untouched.

codeant_findings.claim: Changing refused fields to STUB_NOT_FOUND makes run_s2's counter treat every refusal as a sourced field, because it compares the source with the exact NOT_FOUND sentinel. s2_extraction_scored can falsely pass.
codeant_findings.fix: run_ground_truth.py now uses startswith(NOT_FOUND), the rule tests/test_extract_outage.py has always used. The equality test was already wrong and was merely unreachable until the refusal string changed.
codeant_findings.mutation: Reverting to != turns test_a_refusal_that_states_a_reason_is_still_a_refusal red. A control test beside it keeps refusing-to-count-refusals from becoming refusing-to-count-values.
codeant_findings.note: This finding was against a defect introduced by this branch. It is the first time the controlled review caught a regression the author shipped rather than one already in main.

reanchoring_note: GitHub moved the comment's commit_id forward from b2b2958 to c9d0fe6 while the review itself still records b2b2958. The verdict was reached by re-running the pack and reading the numbers, not from comment metadata.
what_this_pr_fixes: run_ground_truth.py exited 2 (INVALIDATED) on every invocation: pack_validator accepted the generic name `main`, bound to main(argv), and was handed a Path. No number from the pack had ever been quotable.
The extraction section reported BLOCKED awaiting a file that was committed, because build_ground_truth.py had none of the names pack_loader looks for.
EXIT 1 and EXIT 2 are now scored separately and measured: EXIT 1 FAIL (0 of 80, required 76, owner Q4 = B), EXIT 2 PASS (20 of 20 explicit with a reason).
StubExtractor's bare not_found now states a reason, which EXIT 2 requires.
